description: The insured vehicle, a 2021 white Kia Sportage (plate E-123456), was backing out of a parking space in the Supermercado Nacional lot when it collided with a parked 2015 Honda Civic (plate F-789012) owned by Ms. Laura Peña. The incident occurred on August 22, 2026, at 02:15 PM. No injuries were sustained by either party, and police were not called as it was a minor incident on private property where parties exchanged information. The impact caused damage to the insured vehicle, specifically: the rear bumper corner (right) is cracked and scuffed, requiring repair and repaint; the rear right taillight has a cracked lens and needs replacement; and there are minor paint scuffs on the rear requiring touch-up.
